user_statement: good idea - but keep in mind in T zone u see both long square cells and periderm cell, if the model only see long square then that is endo
definition: Mixed/T-zone appearance requires both elongated orderly Endoderm cells and shorter irregular Periderm cells on the main root. Long orderly rectangular cells alone are Endoderm. T is the left edge of the mixed zone. Lateral-root cells do not define main-root T.
implementation_limit: Current appearance head predicts the presence of each appearance in windows; it does not explicitly segment, identify or count individual cells. Both predicted scores must pass0.5 for a mixed call. Those scores can be wrong.
